decisions.reason: A one-tier pyramid sits in the firm's core craft routine and seasonal demand stayed solid, so even though it no longer appears on the website it likely still meets aspirations at low cost.

The electronic music box line was presented as a strategic flagship, and slack from industry growth lets management keep it despite its distance from the core and its absence from the website since 2019.

A minor, distant accessory platform that was never prominent and has not been visible since 2019 likely falls short of aspirations, and its sibling platform D was already dropped, so its resources are better used in core pyramid production.

The Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on established workshop competencies and fits collector demand, so despite the uncertainty from its absence on the website it likely performs near aspiration.
